description: Small synthetic dataset for demonstrating TRACEAI provenance tracking, similarity analysis, and evidence trail generation. All records are project-created and clearly labelled SYNTHETIC.
similarity_demo_note: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH are DEMO REVIEW CATEGORIES only. They are NOT legal conclusions. HIGH means the record requires provenance and licence review before use in AI training.

versioning_policy.future_1.x: Metadata corrections or field additions — backward compatible
versioning_policy.future_2.0: Major structural change to dataset or new record modalities

limitations: All records are synthetic and project-created
Not representative of enterprise-scale AI training datasets
Does not establish legal ownership or copyright compliance
Does not verify or claim any external licence
Similarity categories are review indicators only — not legal determinations
External source verification is required before production use
